description: Search everything Well Prepped Life publishes — service pages, city pages, guides, and the FAQ set — and get back real URLs plus any matching FAQ answer in our own words. Use this for ANY question get_services does not cover: a medical diet (renal, diabetic, soft food, low sodium), insurance and Medicare coverage, a specific city or ZIP, hospital discharge, cost comparisons, how delivery works. Quote the returned faq answers and cite the returned URLs; if nothing comes back, say we do not have that published rather than inventing an answer.

limit.description: How many pages to return (default 6, max 12).

query.description: The customer's question in their own words, e.g. 'does Medicare pay for this', 'mom is on dialysis and cannot chew', 'do you deliver to Oakland', 'how much per week'.

name: find_answer
